As a reminder: Nvidia sells a huge number of chips to China. If we got rid of export controls, they’d make much more money.

It’s massively in Nvidia’s interests to lobby against export restrictions. It spends millions on lobbying, including on export controls. https://t.co/kuWv5qs0u1

Treasury just proposed a very  significant expansion of its outbound programs. A lot to unpack, but the following proposed expansions jump out on an initial read: 
1️⃣ Broadly prohibits investment in developing AI/super intelligence, irrespective of end-user and amount of compute
